name: The Woodlands

routes.outcome: First-party The Woodlands Township ArcGIS parcel Feature Layer found; service description says it is a parcel feature data service and credits The Woodlands Township, Montgomery Central Appraisal District, and Harris County Appraisal District. No unsafe fields were requested.
Related first-party The Woodlands CAD_AGIS service found with a parcel layer and public REST metadata; treated as corroborating local GIS evidence, not as the primary query route.

Anonymous layer metadata returned polygon geometry, WKID 102100/3857 native extent, GeoJSON support, maxRecordCount 10000, and fields including PID, OBJECTID, ParcelID, PLATID, and GlobalID. Full source schema was inspected but unsafe attributes were not requested for parcel responses.

Exact immutable WUP point query used geometry point [-95.5060077599405,30.174927425283] in EPSG:4326, esriGeometryPoint, esriSpatialRelIntersects, outFields=PID,GlobalID, returnGeometry=true, outSR=4326. It returned one polygon with PID 8939 and GlobalID {9D6F9C43-BBAA-45B3-B338-C9B033D73088}.

Bounded nearby envelope query used [-95.5065,30.1745,-95.5055,30.1755] in EPSG:4326, outFields=PID,GlobalID, returnGeometry=true, outSR=4326, resultRecordCount=3. It returned three polygon features with PID 8940, 8938, and 9039; unchanged response is retained only under ignored tmp/valhalla-parcel-research/6381/sample-query.geojson.

schemaAndCrs.viewerConfig: The Woodlands Township ArcGIS REST FeatureServer parcel layer at https://tharcgis2.thewoodlands-tx.gov/arcgis/rest/services/PARCELS/FeatureServer/0
schemaAndCrs.geometryCrs: Native layer extent is WKID 102100 / Web Mercator; requests were made in EPSG:4326 and returned geometry in EPSG:4326.
schemaAndCrs.nativeIdentity: GlobalID is the preferred stable native identity; PID was also observed as the property ID. No synthetic row number was used.

sourceFieldMapping.PID: observed native property ID; not retained in a sample
sourceFieldMapping.OBJECTID: observed ArcGIS object ID; not retained

schemaAndCrs.compositeKeyProvenance: No composite key used; GlobalID is exposed by the official layer as a native GlobalID field. PID was retained in ignored request evidence only for cross-checking.

qualification.reason: A real first-party local parcel map/API and safe anonymous ID-plus-geometry responses were evidenced, but runtime/admission remains held pending independent serial review.

scopeLimits: The exact WUP point was preserved and not shifted.
The exact point intersects one parcel in the first-party layer; this does not establish citywide completeness.
The nearby envelope was bounded and returned three polygons; larger or unchanged raw evidence remains only under ignored tmp/valhalla-parcel-research/6381/.

The Woodlands Township GIS service is the evidenced local map custodian; MCAD and HCAD are credited data contributors in the service metadata, while no separate county recorder workflow was established.
No retained GeoJSON sample was created, so no source-specific attribute set was retained in cohort artifacts.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, certificate, or personal fields were requested or retained.
This packet is not source integration or admission; runtimeReadiness remains held.
uncertainty: The public first-party layer is queryable and returned polygon geometry at the immutable point, but publication/update cadence, legal authority relative to county appraisal/recording systems, and citywide completeness were not independently verified. The service exposes many additional legacy fields that were intentionally excluded.
